deep 300k.interpretation: planner_vs_native_only < 1 means the selector improves on the best native arm by routing to aligned PGD-G where it is faster; planner_vs_aligned_pgdg < 1 means the selector is faster than always routing to aligned PGD-G, thanks to the native deep/other wins.
